title: Glassdoor Jobs Scraper
description: Collect the visible cards from US Glassdoor job search results.

searchUrls.title: Glassdoor search URLs
searchUrls.description: Paste up to five public job search URLs from www.glassdoor.com.

maxItems.title: Maximum jobs
maxItems.description: Maximum unique jobs across all searches.

maxPages.title: Maximum batches per search
maxPages.description: The initial results count as one batch. Additional batches use Show more jobs.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Glassdoor blocks datacenter IPs. Keep the Apify residential proxy (default).
